parents.subject: Less Commonly Taught Languages
parents.course: Intermediate Course in a Less Commonly Taught Language I

ns2:section.sectionText: A selection of Turkish printed texts in Arabic script from the nineteenth and twentieth centuries is introduced in order of difficulty. Hakan Karateke's unpublished "Ottoman Reader" serves as a textbook. The texts are drawn from historical textbooks, official documents, novels, and other genres. This section is offered through the BTAA Course Share Program hosted by University of Chicago and will be video-conference/Zoom/online taught for participating universities.
